create_finetune_dataset: run the script to convert ASE atoms files into ASE database files for fine-tuning ML models
compute_normalizer_and_linear_reference: compute the force RMS normalizer value and linear reference coefficients from an ASE database training dataset
extract_energy_and_forces: extract atomic numbers, potential energy, and forces from an ASE atoms object at a given dataset index
compute_lin_ref: compute linear reference coefficients by fitting atomic composition features to energies using least squares regression
launch_processing: launch parallel processing to convert a directory of ASE atoms files into chunked ASE database files
